data.body: [P2] Preserve the existing public record shape. Adding an eighth component breaks recompilation of Java 21+ consumers using seven-component `InvocationInfo` record patterns. Retaining constructors and documenting the migration do not preserve this usage; the new compatibility test explicitly expects compilation failure. Keep the seven-component record and carry the header through separate immutable metadata with backward-compatible hook/extractor overloads that delegate to existing methods. Update the regression test to require the unchanged legacy pattern to compile successfully.
